COPY lab/h034/companion-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/h034-companion
RUN chmod 0555 /usr/local/bin/h034-companion

ENV COMPANION_ADMIN_PORT=8000
ENV COMPANION_CONFIG_BASEDIR=/companion
ENV PATH="/app/node-runtimes/main/bin:${PATH}"
EXPOSE 8000 16622
USER root
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/h034-companion"]

COPY lab/h034/install-companion-module.sh /usr/local/bin/h034-install-companion-module
RUN chmod 0555 /usr/local/bin/h034-install-companion-module \
  && mkdir -p /app/module-local-dev /companion /evidence \
  && h034-install-companion-module \
    /opt/h034/overlaykit-server-0.1.0.tgz \
    /app/module-local-dev/overlaykit-server \

RUN npm ci --engine-strict --no-audit --no-fund --maxsockets=1 \
  && npm run package:module \
  && sha256sum pkg/overlaykit-server-0.1.0.tgz > /tmp/module.sha256

COPY lab/h034/overlaykit-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/h034-overlaykit
RUN mkdir -p /data /evidence \
  && chmod 0555 /usr/local/bin/h034-overlaykit \
  && chown -R overlaykit:overlaykit /data /evidence

ENV H034_OVERLAYKIT_COMMIT="${OVERLAYKIT_COMMIT}"
ENV NODE_PATH=/opt/overlaykit/node_modules
EXPOSE 3000 8081 9090
USER root
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/h034-overlaykit"]

COPY lab/h034/overlaykit-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/h034-overlaykit
RUN mkdir -p /data /evidence \
